who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code, lane astlog-sema-1113
where: crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/job.rs Jobs::applied (writer.apply() on the loop), serve/unit.rs serve_written, serve/unit/deps.rs PagedRecord::of (frame::current, added by f25aa5be3c)
what: An edit, a query or a reach whose view needs units applied first fails with `the proc macros and build scripts its front end applies did not apply: serving from the store the dependencies of ...` when a served record is read, not mapped (under MAP_FROM or still in a writer segment): the daemon panics at deps.rs:1712 with `frame::current outside any frame::task` on thread main. Backtrace: Jobs::happened, did, wrote, after, units_applied, applied, UnitWriter::apply, serve_written, deps::serve, deps::images, hir_ty::method_resolution::frozen::serve, Images::pages, PagedRecord::of. Seen on macOS with a debug blaze of 192808b17a: 5 of 5 requests on one home whose store an earlier daemon left; 0 of 9 on a fresh home; 0 of 4 with release builds of main 4630d47 and of the branch on blaze-vm.
cost: an hour to find; `blaze check --query`, `--rules` and `--replace` fail on such a home until one `blaze check` has run
cause: Jobs::applied applies the view writer on the loop without the loop Lender (`w.reads.lend`), which the two other loop-side store reads use for their driver and their Tag::Plane frame; the read that needs a frame came with f25aa5be3c (records read in place)
class: a store read made on the loop outside the Lender
prevention: one entry point for a loop-side apply that lends the driver and the frame, and a serve test whose fake writer checks it runs in a frame when applied on the loop
workaround: run `blaze check` once on that home first
fix: 2b9f16c91c on astlog-daemon-1113: Jobs::units_applied sends a write still waiting at the build's end to a write's task (Jobs::send_write, as apply_writes sends every other) and ends the build when the writer comes back; a write that broke on its task fails the job naming the view. The loop applies nothing, so no apply runs outside a frame. The Lender (`w.reads.lend(|| writer.apply())`) was not taken: it gives a frame but keeps the apply on the loop, against the_loop_applies_no_front_end_write_over_many_seeds. Test: a_query_applies_its_views_writes_on_a_write_task_in_a_frame_over_many_seeds (32 seeds, no apply on the loop or outside a frame); control, the send removed: seeds 12, 21 and 26 apply on the loop in no frame. The real home did not reproduce on clones at another path with the base debug binary (0 of 4 requests), so the before/after on a real store is not shown.
